description: This file implements the UniformIntegerDistribution class, representing a discrete uniform distribution with specified lower and upper bounds, including methods for probability calculation, sampling, and distribution properties.

classes.name: UniformIntegerDistribution
classes.description: A class implementing a discrete uniform distribution over a specified integer range, providing probability, cumulative probability, mean, variance, support bounds, and sampling capabilities.

methods.name: probability
methods.description: Returns the probability of a specific integer value within the distribution.

methods.name: cumulativeProbability
methods.description: Computes the cumulative probability up to a given value.

methods.name: getNumericalMean
methods.description: Calculates the mean of the distribution, which is the midpoint of the bounds.

methods.name: getNumericalVariance
methods.description: Calculates the variance of the distribution based on the bounds.

methods.name: getSupportLowerBound
methods.description: Returns the lower bound of the distribution's support.

methods.name: getSupportUpperBound
methods.description: Returns the upper bound of the distribution's support.

methods.name: isSupportConnected
methods.description: Indicates that the support of the distribution is connected.

methods.name: sample
methods.description: Generates a random sample from the distribution.
